items.title: ROSEN, A LONGSTANDING FIRM, Encourages Everest Group, Ltd. Investors to Secure Counsel Before Important Deadline in Securities Class Action - EG
items.summary: Rosen Law Firm is notifying investors about multiple ongoing securities class action lawsuits. The primary case involves Everest Group, Ltd., where investors who purchased stock between February 8, 2024 and October 27, 2025 may be entitled to compensation. The lawsuit alleges Everest made false statements about casualty risk exposure, inadequate pricing, and insufficient reserves. Additional class actions are mentioned for Lincoln Educational Services Corporation and Dun & Bradstreet Holdings, Inc., with a November 10, 2026 deadline.

items.title: ROSEN, NATIONAL INVESTOR COUNSEL, Encourages Everest Group, Ltd. Investors to Secure Counsel Before Important Deadline in Securities Class Action - EG
items.summary: Rosen Law Firm has filed a class action lawsuit against Everest Group, Ltd. (NYSE: EG) on behalf of investors who purchased common stock between February 8, 2024 and October 27, 2025. The lawsuit alleges that Everest made materially false and misleading statements regarding its exposure to casualty risks, inadequate pricing, insufficient reserves, and overstated earnings. Investors who wish to serve as lead plaintiff must file by December 28, 2026.

items.title: INVESTOR NOTICE: Everest Group, Ltd. Investors with Substantial Losses May Seek to Lead Class Action Lawsuit Before December 28, 2026 Deadline, RGRD Law Announces - EG
items.summary: Robbins Geller Rudman & Dowd LLP announces a class action lawsuit against Everest Group, Ltd. for alleged securities fraud. The lawsuit claims the company made false statements about its casualty risk exposure, inadequate pricing, and insufficient reserves that overstated earnings. Investors who purchased EG stock between February 8, 2024 and October 27, 2025 can seek appointment as lead plaintiff before the December 28, 2026 deadline.

items.title: Everest Group, Ltd. Notice of December 28, 2026 Application Deadline for Class Action Lawsuit - Contact Lewis Kahn, Esq. at Kahn Swick & Foti, LLC, Before Application Deadline
items.summary: Kahn Swick & Foti, LLC announces a class action securities lawsuit against Everest Group, Ltd. for investors who purchased stock between February 8, 2024 and October 27, 2025. The lawsuit alleges that Everest made materially false statements about its Insurance division's casualty reserves. In October 2025, the company disclosed $478 million in unfavorable prior year reserve development and secured $1.2 billion in protection against further adverse development. The stock price fell 11.4% following the disclosure. The application deadline to request lead plaintiff status is December 28, 2026.

items.title: ROSEN, TRUSTED INVESTOR COUNSEL, Encourages Everest Group, Ltd. Investors to Secure Counsel Before Important Deadline in Securities Class Action - EG
items.summary: Rosen Law Firm has filed securities class action lawsuits against Everest Group, Papa John's International, and Qfin Holdings on behalf of investors who purchased common stock during specified periods. The lawsuit against Everest Group alleges the company made false statements regarding casualty risk exposure, inadequate pricing, and insufficient reserves that overstated earnings. Investors are encouraged to secure counsel before upcoming deadlines.

items.title: EG Shareholder Notice: Shareholder Rights Law Firm Robbins LLP Reminds Investors of the Class Action Lawsuit Against Everest Group, Ltd.
items.summary: Robbins LLP announced class action lawsuits against Everest Group, Ltd. for allegedly misleading investors about its U.S. casualty insurance business risks and reserve adequacy. The lawsuit covers purchases between February 2024 and October 2025, with Everest's stock declining significantly after disclosures of $478 million in unfavorable reserve development and a $1.2 billion protection agreement. Additional class actions were filed against O-I Glass, Inc. for misrepresenting financial outlook and Tenax Therapeutics, Inc. for misleading claims about its drug candidate levosimendan.

items.title: ROSEN, A RANKED AND LEADING LAW FIRM, Encourages Everest Group, Ltd. Investors to Secure Counsel Before Important Deadline in Securities Class Action - EG
items.summary: Rosen Law Firm has filed class action lawsuits against Everest Group, Ltd., FuelCell Energy, Inc., and DICK'S Sporting Goods, Inc. on behalf of investors who purchased securities during specified periods. The firm is seeking lead plaintiffs and encouraging investors to join the litigation. The Everest Group lawsuit alleges materially false statements regarding casualty risk exposure, inadequate pricing, and insufficient reserves.

items.title: CELH IMPORTANT DEADLINE: ROSEN, HIGHLY RECOGNIZED INVESTOR COUNSEL, Encourages Celsius Holdings, Inc. Investors to Secure Counsel Before Important November 3 Deadline in Securities Class Action - CELH
items.summary: Rosen Law Firm is encouraging investors in Celsius Holdings (CELH) who purchased securities between February 21, 2025 and June 3, 2026 to join a class action lawsuit before the November 3, 2026 deadline. The lawsuit alleges that Celsius made materially false and misleading statements regarding cardiac risks associated with its Alani Nu products and inappropriately marketed these products to consumers under 18. Similar class action notices are being issued for Everest Group, Ltd. (EG) and FuelCell Energy, Inc. (FCEL).

items.title: Everest Group Q3 Earnings Miss Estimates on Higher Catastrophe Losses
items.summary: Everest Group reported Q3 2026 operating EPS of $7.62, missing estimates by 18.8%, with revenues declining 14% to $3.71 billion. The company faced an underwriting loss of $223 million due to elevated catastrophe losses and adverse reserve development, pushing the combined ratio to 107.1%. However, investment income surged 17.4% to a record $634 million. Comparatively, peers Chubb, Travelers, and Arch Capital beat earnings expectations in the same quarter.
